scheme_name: Readers Allowance to Visually Impaired Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must be a visually impaired student
Applicant must be enrolled in 9th standard or above in a recognized/bonafide institution
benefits_summary: Provides an annual readers allowance of ₹3,000 for 9th‑10th standards, ₹5,000 for degree courses, and ₹6,000 for postgraduate/professional courses.
